notes.title: GNS2 Demo, Update 2 - Photo Mode
notes.notes:
Photo Mode is finally available and now you can take beautiful screenshots using many different settings.

You can enter Photo Mode from the pause menu while in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591217/d9be790580829194f079e395fb889abaf8e72ab1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: GNS2 Demo - Update 1
Demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Great North Shelter 2 is available now.

The demo is fully playable: there is autosave, all the necessary settings, full support for Xbox and PS gamepads, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591217/786f5fb85dd97b8a9d9c2f9af3268c483d7e7fe9.jpg[/img]

You can try some mechanics of Great North Shelter 2, feel the atmosphere.
This game loves experiments: try to go outside the map, press some button many times, interact with the object multiple times.
There are many details hidden around, so curious players will be able to find something interesting.

We hope you enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591217/745ac07f1acb64eb03d8216668db50d1458360e0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Monuments
notes.notes:
Between locations you will find "Monuments". These are unusual objects with a pretty detailed description. All Monuments can be interacted with, and some of them cause interesting events. 
And sometimes pretty strange, unpredictable events.
After interaction, information about the Monument is saved to the journal.
